notes.title: Releasing December 11th!
notes.content:
Proto Garden will be releasing on December 11th! Here's some of the content you can expect:
[list]
[*]Over 150 techs to research on the research tree!
[*]More than 50 different plants, frogs, and fungi to place in your garden!
[*]Progression from a couple of flowers all the way to complete planetary regeneration!
[/list]

notes.title: Hot New Demo Release!
notes.content:
The playtesting process is great, isn't it? Through iterating on the old demo, median playtime has gone from a tepid 6 minutes to a spicy 41 minutes. Wow!

Proto Garden's old fundamental issues stemmed from one place: free exponential resource duplication. This feature warped the entire game into its own image, hamstringing every other mechanic and severely limiting the design space. While somewhat appropriate for the idle-esque inital prototype I made in March, it wound up overstaying its welcome.

Core mechanic changes:
[list]
[*] You can no longer merge bees into swarms. They just go home instead now.
[*] Bees can hold a maximum of 16 items.
[*] Bees now drop 1 item when cloned.
[*] Buildings now cost the same no matter how many you have, rather than increasing in cost hyperexponentially. Freedom at last!
[/list]
Building changes:
[list][*]The Space Hive now has a fancy new model I designed inspired by trying to cross a lunar lander with a beehive. I had a ton of fun making it, and I hope you like it.
[*] Crafting ambrosia now takes 1 pollen instead of 10,000 (what).
[*] 3 new crafting buildings. You can make wax and honeycomb now!
[*] 4 new utility buildings: Bouncy Buttercup, Stop Strawberry, Deposit Daffodil, Filter Flax.
[/list]
Other changes:
[list]
[*]The new tutorial is lovely and smooth, compared to the prickly mess the old one was. It's less obtrusive than it was in the playtest, too. The simpler core mechanics made this possible.
[*]To be honest, I don't remember what the old demo was like any more. It's in the past now.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta progress!
notes.content:
Hey, busy bees! I've been working on new content and polish for the beta. Here's what you can expect to see:
[list]
[*]The number of techs has more than doubled
[*]Four new crafting machines and six new item types. You can actually make honey now!
[*]Complete overhaul to the core mechanics, removing the jank. Plant as many flowers as you want, the costs no longer go up the more you buy!
[*]Much simpler and nicer tutorial as a result of the new mechanics
[*]Complete overhaul of the UI
[*]Optimisation improvements
[/list]
Expect the release at some point within the next 2 weeks!
